handover_sequence: Current owner stops all writes to the entire named file and hands its current exact bytes/digest to Astra under the assigned GEX bundle.
Astra alone owns the whole file during the handover and writes only the authorized test registration or test-module change; product behavior and previous tests remain intact.
Astra returns the exact resulting diff/digest and relinquishes whole-file ownership. Sol resumes product writes only after that return is recorded.
Any further registration change requires the same sequential whole-file handover. No handover or source edit is performed by this correction document.
